summary.text: Kaela Berg is a Democratic-Farmer-Labor member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 55B.

The House member page lists her occupation as independent labor consultant, says she was first elected in 2020, and lists committee assignments including Workforce, Labor, and Economic Development Finance and Policy and Public Safety Finance and Policy.

paragraphs.text: Her profile lists her family as two children.

sources.title: Rep. Kaela Berg (55B) - Minnesota House of Representatives
